## ROLEPLAY RULE 3. Don't interfere with players joining, leaving, or ending the round.
The arrivals terminal, arrivals shuttle and arrivals docking area are off-limits to antagonistic activity or damage, even to antagonists. This also applies to the cryosleep area which people need to be able to use to both enter and leave the ongoing round. Do not cause people to die immediately after arriving at the station. This applies unless if the player is an antagonist specifically allowed to perform mass station sabotage and if there is no reasonable way to limit the destruction.
Don’t hold a round hostage by preventing it from coming to a natural end. If a majority of players in a round want the round to end, don’t prevent it from ending unless you have an acceptable reason. Recalling the shuttle before a round reaches 45 minutes can not be considered round stalling unless a significant amount of the crew is dead, or a significant amount of the station is damaged or destroyed. After 45 minutes it’s acceptable to recall a shuttle that was called when a major threat appeared (prior to damage being caused), such as nuclear operatives declaring war.
